argv: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $t=@(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:17447/json/list' -TimeoutSec 4); $v=@($t | Where-Object { $_.url -like 'https://www.avito.ru/krasnoyarsk/telefony*' } | Select-Object id,title,url); [ordered]@{ at=(Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('o'); count=$t.Count; iphoneTabs=$v } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress

note: Read-only CDP inventory of public Avito phone listings on isolated no-proxy Chrome 17447; do not change tabs, browser focus, proxy, running tasks or system.
